title:
Palliative Care Training session 5, for Rolie, Matt and Grace Springhill Hospice

Palliative care training equips healthcare professionals and support workers with essential skills to improve the quality of life for patients facing life-limiting illnesses and their families. It focuses on holistic, person-centred care, covering symptom management, communication, psychological support, and ethical, legal, or spiritual considerations.
